answer_1.quote: In recent years, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have witnessed rapid development and have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across a wide range of multimodal tasks.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate responses to visual questions (VQA) and extract text from document images (OCR), which are natural language generation tasks in the document understanding domain.

answer_2.quote: The ANLS metric is widely used in document understanding to measure text similarity on a scale from 0 to 1.
